تبتهجين (form VIII)
# تَبْتَهِجِينَ (tabtahijīna) /tab.ta.hi.d͡ʒiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
# تُبْتَهَجِينَ (tubtahajīna) /tub.ta.ha.d͡ʒiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَهَجَ (ibtahaja)
